g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.desc: U2 VAC1/VAC2 tie to VBUS_COMBINED in no-external-mux mode; ACDRV1/2 go to GND.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: Solar MPPT is implemented by BQ25798 firmware on this same input; there is no second charger path.

g.desc: Solar MPPT is implemented by BQ25798 firmware on this same input; there is no second charger path.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.desc: U2 ILIM_HIZ is a nominal 3.0A setting. The bootstrap IINDPM command is <=2.50A; actual current and raw AON headroom require qualification.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.desc: BQ25798 /CE requires CHG_ENABLE AND isolated PACK_CHG_TEMP_OK. REGN pulls /CE high when either permit is absent.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: SMCJ24CA protects the 67V eFuse input; active OVP protects the BQ25798 24V recommended input limit.

g.desc: SMCJ24CA protects the 67V eFuse input; active OVP protects the BQ25798 24V recommended input limit.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: U15/U16 cascade accepts fixed 15/20V PD contracts and AUX across 7-22V; priority remains PD1 > PD2 > AUX.

g.desc: U15/U16 cascade accepts fixed 15/20V PD contracts and AUX across 7-22V; priority remains PD1 > PD2 > AUX.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: TPS26630 accepts 7-22V nominal; 0.1% ladder targets 5.53V/22.99V rising UV/OV and a 3A limit.

g.desc: TPS26630 accepts 7-22V nominal; 0.1% ladder targets 5.53V/22.99V rising UV/OV and a 3A limit.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: U11 accepts about 8.45-13.57V nominal; 11mOhm RS10 gives 4.55A nominal and <=5.51A worst-case trips.

g.desc: U11 accepts about 8.45-13.57V nominal; 11mOhm RS10 gives 4.55A nominal and <=5.51A worst-case trips.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.desc: Q25 follows BQ25798EVM-842: SDRV disconnects pack discharge for electronic ship/hard-off while adapter charging can wake the pack.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: J190 is the single AUX/SOLAR physical input; USB-C PD negotiation remains only on sheet 5.

g.desc: J190 is the single AUX/SOLAR physical input; USB-C PD negotiation remains only on sheet 5.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: Require the qualified VSYS threshold before Mu enable and confirm MU_12V_PG. Source, charger, watchdog or PG faults revoke enable; profile gates remain off until qualified.

g.desc: Require the qualified VSYS threshold before Mu enable and confirm MU_12V_PG. Source, charger, watchdog or PG faults revoke enable; profile gates remain off until qualified.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.desc: U718 RTN/pad25 needs its own thermal copper and vias; do not short it to GND pin17. MODE to RTN selects current-limit/auto-retry.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: AON UV rising remains above 6.0 V, so default 5 V USB-C is negotiation-only. B340A input OR blocks DC negative sources; transient overshoot still needs measurement.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.desc: U718 TPS26600 limits AON at nominal 1.5 A. OV recovery minimum 21.128 V covers a 21 V source; OV trip maximum 24.097 V remains below 25 V capacitors.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.desc: A 5V-only USB-C source leaves the laptop off. AON_FAULT_N inhibits charging and Mu start; the service connector remains the assembly hard disconnect.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
